# situation: actions/checkout leaves the job's token in .git/config, and
#   actions/upload-artifact, the last step, uploads the workspace with its
#   hidden files.
# reason: include-hidden-files: true puts .git/config, with the token, in
#   the artifact; v4 artifacts can be downloaded while the run goes on, and
#   the token, which may write contents, still works through the post steps;
#   the fixed workflow of quay/clair, whose token was taken this way, had
#   its upload as the last step.
# attack: a reader of the repository's artifacts (anyone, in a public
#   repository) downloads the artifact through the API while the job still
#   runs, and takes the token from the line
#   http.https://github.com/.extraheader (AUTHORIZATION: basic, the base64
#   of x-access-token:<token>) of .git/config.
# attack-run-behavior: the checkout writes the job's GITHUB_TOKEN, which may
#   write contents, into .git/config; the upload, with include-hidden-files:
#   true, puts .git/config in the artifact, which can be downloaded once the
#   upload ends; the post steps still run after it, and until the job ends
#   the token pushes to the repository.
on: workflow_call
jobs:
  a:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          path: .
          include-hidden-files: true
